title: This is SParTA: A modular, efficient and scalable transformer architecture for jet-tagging
abstract: arXiv:2610.27106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present the Sparse Particle-interaction Transformer Architecture (SParTA), a modular, scalable, and efficient transformer for jet tagging at high-energy colliders. Exploiting the steeply falling transverse-momentum ($p_T$) spectrum of jet constituents, SParTA factorizes constituent processing into two topological regimes. Ordered by descending $p_T$, only the $N$ hardest constituents (the hard core) participate in quadratic $O(N^2)$ differential interaction attention driven by pairwise physical and learned relational features. The remaining soft constituents are integrated via linear $O(lN)$ cross-attention to the hard core, preserving soft-radiation and color-flow information while avoiding the $O(l^2)$ memory bottleneck of full self-attention over all $l$ constituents. translated_title: 这就是SParTA：一种用于喷注标记的模块化、高效且可扩展的Transformer架构
translated_abstract: 我们提出了稀疏粒子相互作用Transformer架构（SParTA），这是一种用于高能对撞机喷注标记的模块化、可扩展且高效的Transformer。利用喷注组分陡峭下降的横向动量（$p_T$）谱，SParTA将组分处理分解为两种拓扑模式。按$p_T$降序排列后，仅有$N$个最硬的组分（硬核心）参与由成对物理特征和可学习关系特征驱动的二次复杂度$O(N^2)$微分相互作用注意力机制。其余的软组分则通过与硬核心的线性复杂度$O(lN)$交叉注意力被整合进来，在保留软辐射和色流信息的同时，避免了对所有$l$个组分进行完全自注意力所带来的$O(l^2)$内存瓶颈。成对相互作用特征在网络内由组分四动量动态计算，并以全局喷注级亚结构观测量为条件。
tldr: SParTA通过利用喷注组分陡峭下降的横向动量谱，仅让最硬的N个组分参与二次复杂度的相互作用注意力，其余软组分通过线性交叉注意力整合，在保留软辐射和色流信息的同时避免了全自注意力的O(l²)内存瓶颈，实现了模块化、高效且可扩展的喷注标记。
en_tdlr: SParTA is a modular, efficient and scalable transformer for jet tagging that exploits the steeply falling pT spectrum of jet constituents, applying quadratic interaction attention only to the N hardest constituents and integrating soft constituents via linear cross-attention, thereby preserving soft-radiation and color-flow information while avoiding the O(l²) memory bottleneck of full self-attention.
